newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms Matsushita, units' long-term AA ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Matsushita, units' long-term AA ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had affirmed Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd's and its units' long-term ratings of AA and short-term ratings of A-1+.
The move followed Matsushita's announcement on Tuesday that it would write off its 104 billion yen in loans and equity invested in its subsidiary NL Finance Ltd.

S&P said in a statement it had maintained a conservative view of asset quality problems at NL Finance and had already factored a potential write-off of this magnitude into the ratings. The outlook of the rating was stable, it said.

"Matsushita's healthy cash flow and strong financial resources give it the flexibility to address its business challenges with little threat to its credit standing over the next couple of years," S&P said.
The Matsushita units whose ratings were affirmed were MFC MTN Corp, Panasonic Finance Inc, Panasonic Finance (Netherlands) BV and Panasonic International (UK) Plc.
As expected, Matsushita would rely on huge unrealised gains in its securities portfolio to minimise the impact of the write-off on its cash flow and capital structure, S&P said.
It said the company plans to sell securities in an amount equivalent to the write-off.
Following these actions, Matsushita would continue to have a very strong financial profile and a large store of cash and marketable securities, S&P said.
In addition, it said, Matsushita retained its leading worldwide position across a broad range of consumer electronics products, home appliances and other products,

Due to the favourable convergence of a greater contribution from higher-value-added products, cost cuts, rising demand and a weaker yen, Matsushita was currently enjoying strong earnings growth, S&P said.
